name: engineering-kit
description: Engineering skills for AI coding agents, vetted and pinned: bug diagnosis, test-first work, architecture scans, plan interviews, retros, primary-source research, setup wizards and read-only PostgreSQL investigations. Every command runs only when you call it, unless you choose at install to let /engineer and /database start on their own.

start_mode.title: How should /engineer and /database start?
start_mode.description: typed: /engineer and /database runs only when you type it. automatic: the assistant also starts /engineer and /database when you ask for engineering or PostgreSQL work in your own words.
